scenario.name: OSPF adjacency failure
scenario.description: An MTU change on the Bengaluru WAN edge leaves the OSPF adjacency stuck in EXSTART.

incident.title: Bengaluru office lost access to data centre applications
incident.description: Bengaluru users cannot reach ERP or the internet although the WAN circuit shows as up.
symptoms: WAN circuit reported up by carrier

ground_truth.root_cause: The IP MTU on BLR-RTR-01 Gi0/0/0 was changed to 1400 while CORE-RTR-02 Gi0/0/2 uses 1500; the OSPF area 10 adjacency is stuck in EXSTART and all routes between Bengaluru and the core were withdrawn.
